data.readme:
1. 优化 Switch 2 唤醒的稳定性。
2. 优化 Switch 模式的陀螺仪效果。
data.readme_en:
1. Optimized controller stability for the Switch 2 wake-up function.
2. Optimized gyro performance in Switch mode.

data.readme:
1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机摇晃唤醒。（操作视频：https://b23.tv/C7Bcc0V）
2. 优化 S 模式的体感效果。
3. 调整移动版 App 连接方式为手动启用：开机后按住配置键 2 秒至配置指示灯闪烁。
4. 新增支持精英软件 V2 for macOS。（需要最新版软件）
5. 优化摇杆启用无死区时的精准度。
6. 修复部分场景调用 amiibo 时导致手柄异常的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for shake-to-wake feature on the Switch 2 console. (Instructional Video: https://youtu.be/kLT-fUVxsBU)
2. Optimized the motion control experience in S Mode.
3. Changed the mobile app connection to manual activation: Hold the Profile button for 2 seconds after powering on until the Profile LED blinks.
4. Added support for Ultimate Software V2 on macOS. (Latest version required)
5. Optimized the precision of the joystick without dead zone.
6. Fixed an issue where using amiibo in certain situations could cause the controller to be abnormal.

data.readme:
1。优化摇杆无死区的精确度
2。修复 NS 模式 online 游戏异常振动问题。
3。修复扳机键预压问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Optimized joystick precision in deadzone-free mode.
2. Fixed abnormal vibration issue in NS mode during online gameplay.
3. Fixed an issue where the trigger was incorrectly activated without being physically pressed.
